prompt:
You are a personal shopper planning an online shopping search.
Shopper's wardrobe (40 items): bottom: 10 (jeans, shorts, skirt; colors light blue, blue, black, beige); dress: 4 (dress; colors burgundy, black, yellow, brown); outerwear: 7 (leather jacket, denim jacket, coat; colors beige, black, indigo, blue); shoes: 8 (boots, sandals, sneakers; colors black, light blue, yellow, brown); top: 11 (shirt, t-shirt, tank top; colors grey, white, black, navy).
Item they are considering: black tank top (women's; category top; subcategory tank top; color black; material unknown; pattern solid; formality 1/5; style n/a; price $28).
Our wardrobe analysis says SKIP it: Pairs into 30 outfits, but they'd mostly repeat looks you already have; Very similar to your black tank top (0.90 match); $0.93 per new outfit (within your $10 limit).
TASK: find 6 alternative products of the SAME type (women's tank top, category top) that would be better for this wardrobe: DIFFERENT colors, textures, materials or patterns than the considered item (black, unknown material) and than the top colors they already own (grey, white, black, navy), but still easy to wear with their other pieces. Vary them (no two in the same color).
Keep prices roughly between $11 and $45.
Instead of products, return 8 search plans (one per product to look for), each with a short store search query and the attributes the product should have. Queries are run on the search boxes of mid-priced US fashion retailers (Everlane, Marine Layer, Petal & Pup, Princess Polly, Good American, Frank And Oak, Outerknown, Allbirds, ...), so use plain product-title words (no brand names, no adjectives like 'stylish'). Make the plans varied (different colors/materials/types).

linen texture provides variety and pairs well with brown shoes
patterned option to break up solid color bottoms
elevates denim and leather jackets for evening looks
delicate texture adds visual interest without being loud
matches existing yellow shoes and burgundy dresses
unique texture that stands out from basic cotton tanks
soft pastel hue contrasts nicely with black outerwear
